europe_now.title: EU calls for stronger borders after Ceuta migrant crossings
europe_now.summary: The European Union has urged member states to strengthen border controls following a surge of migrants crossing into Ceuta. The move follows a mass crossing that has raised concerns about border security and migration management.

europe_now.title: Europe's record-breaking heat sparks wildfires, drought in France, Greece and the UK
europe_now.summary: Extreme temperatures across Europe have triggered widespread wildfires and severe drought conditions in France, Greece, and the United Kingdom. The heatwave has strained water resources and increased fire risk across the continent.
